evidence: Runtime (private containers r18-app from cw-editor-agent-r3 with the frozen solution installed by solve.sh and launched as tests/test.sh does: uid 65534, env -i, DB_PATH=/app/app.db; r18-browser from cw-editor-verifier:current sharing its network namespace, driven through playwright-mcp 0.0.79 with the judge's flags; both removed afterwards). Installed /app/src/app.tsx sha256 38392f15... equals the frozen file. (1) cw_newer_run_supersedes performed as now instructed (one browser_run_code_unsafe action: click Run, click the code, Ctrl+A, type the new line with key presses, click Run): control marker CTL-A1 appeared in preview and console after ~4 s; four supersede attempts (no delay, 30-40 ms per key, 0/300/1500 ms pause, with and without clicking the code) all PASSED: activeElement after Run = 'Code editor', source replaced, second Run at 0.3-2.9 s, NEW marker shown, console 'Previous run cancelled', OLD marker absent after 10 s. The v10 failure cause (app.tsx run() did not refocus the editor) is fixed. (2) Render gate: typed 'zqgamma' appears; reload with unsaved text raised no dialog and the workspace reloaded (PASS). Constraints gate: focus on DIV role=textbox (not contenteditable), only inputs are title/filename/find/replace, no ready-made editor markers; save of 'Gate Rec R18'/gate-r18.js, full storage clear, reload, open: exact title/filename/source, again after second reload (PASS). (3) 1440x900 layout DEFECT introduced by the v11 CSS change (style.css line 76: '@media (min-width:851px){.library{max-height:none}.snippetlist{max-height:118px;overflow:auto}}'), which removes the library's own scroll (v10 had .library{max-height:36%;overflow:auto}) while .pane keeps overflow:hidden and .library flex-shrink:0. With 27 snippets and a 6-revision snippet opened: .editor.pane bottom 844, .library 620-860 (clientHeight==scrollHeight, so not scrollable), revision chips 823-848 cut by the pane edge. After clicking 'Revision 1', the revision preview (title/filename, Historical source pre at y 864-904, 'Restore selected revision' button) lies entirely below the pane's clipped edge; screenshot shows no preview at all. Mouse wheel over the library and over the history row changes nothing (pane scrollTop stays 48, library and list scrollTop 0, window scrollY 0). Only focus/scrollIntoView reveals it (Tab to Restore scrolls the overflow:hidden pane by 164 px, which then clips the '01 / Editor' heading, title/filename row and half the Find row at the top). Restore itself works via Playwright click (revision added, 'Restored as revision 9'). So binary criteria still pass when the judge clicks by ref and reads the accessibility snapshot, but the reference visibly clips content at desktop size, which cw_visual_workspace_layout explicitly scores ('nothing overlapping or clipped' for 5), and cw_history_restore_adds_revision's 'its exact title, filename and source must be shown' is not visibly met for a judge that confirms by screenshot or tries to scroll. The evidence index's claim 'v11 fixes both Oracle issues' is refuted for the layout issue: the v11 change trades a scrollable library for an unscrollable clipped one. No configured judge run exists on these bytes; no Oracle score is claimed.
counterexample: Install the frozen golden, open it at 1440x900 with ~25 saved snippets, open a snippet with 6 revisions and click 'Revision 1': the screenshot shows no revision preview or Restore button; wheel scrolling does nothing (pane overflow:hidden, library not height-constrained). A visual judge measuring this (as the v10 judge already did for a smaller version of the same problem) will score cw_visual_workspace_layout at most 4, and a judge confirming 'shown' by screenshot can fail cw_history_restore_adds_revision.
suggested_fix: In solution/app/src/style.css keep the library scroll at desktop width (e.g. restore a bounded .library max-height with overflow:auto, or make .editor.pane / the library region overflow-y:auto with min-height:0 and let the code host shrink), so that after selecting a revision its preview and Restore button are reachable by wheel and visible without clipping the pane heading; rebuild the bundle and re-measure at 1440x900 with many snippets and a selected revision.
